label: Percent
conversion_note: A share of farmers or of area. Record the denominator in detail.

label: USD per hectare per year
conversion_note: Deflated to the base year set in harmonize.R. Record the study year and the original currency.
synonyms: US$/ha/yr;USD ha-1 yr-1;dollars per hectare per year

label: USD per hectare
conversion_note: A one off cost. Do not annualise it here. The carbon model does that.

label: Ugandan shilling per hectare per year
conversion_note: Converted at the study year rate then deflated. Keep the original value and unit.

label: Local currency per hectare per year
conversion_note: Any national currency. The currency code goes in detail. Converted the same way as UGX.

label: Person-days per hectare
conversion_note: A labour quantity and not a price. Never converted to currency by the pipeline.
synonyms: man-days/ha;labour days per hectare;person days ha-1

label: Person-days per hectare per year
synonyms: man-days/ha/yr;labour days per hectare per year

label: USD per household
conversion_note: Kept as its own unit. Not converted to a per hectare figure by the pipeline.

label: USD per tonne CO2 equivalent
conversion_note: Used for carbon_share rows. A price is not a cost. Check which the paper means.

label: Ratio
conversion_note: A share expressed as a fraction rather than a percent. Harmonised to pct.

label: Other
conversion_note: No controlled unit fits. The row is listed for the team and the cell stays empty.
